name: gameengine-plugin-dev
description: Development environment for GameEngine WordPress Plugin.

scripts.makepot: npm run i18n:scan && npm run i18n:strings && npm run i18n:rescan
scripts.i18n:scan: php -d memory_limit=-1 "$(command -v wp)" i18n make-pot . languages/gameengine.pot --slug=gameengine --domain=gameengine --exclude=node_modules,vendor,assets/build,languages,build-tools --skip-audit
scripts.i18n:rescan: php -d memory_limit=-1 "$(command -v wp)" i18n make-pot . languages/gameengine.pot --slug=gameengine --domain=gameengine --exclude=node_modules,vendor,dev_gameengine,languages,build-tools,assets/build/backend.js,assets/build/setup.js,assets/build/frontend.js
